items.title: Paul Barbarin Interview, 1960-01-28
items.q: The interviewee mentions 'Russell' in the context of paying off the band ('give Russell, give a little Russell Emble Up') and later discusses Louis Russell as an arranger for King Oliver, but does not describe a direct personal or professional relationship with Louis Russell himself.

ctx.x: What kind of a place was it?

All this place happened to be down in the basement, you know? It was down in the basement. I had a full show there. It was a good show. Casper Holstein, which was the proprietor, he was a very nice man. You didn't have to worry about your money. I mean, whether he did business or not, he always had a smile on his face. You see, if they wouldn't have many people all the week, he never tormented the band, say to the band, and, man, he's not playing. I mean, what's happening to the band, and what's this and what's…
He did a lot of arrangements, you know.
